in_marathi.name: Shriyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth, prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shriyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shriyansh is a Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit words 'shri', which means wealth, prosperity, and 'yansh', which is a variation of 'yan', meaning god. This name is often given to a baby boy, symbolizing the hope and prayer for a prosperous and abundant life.
